description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa Hiya, ambalo huorodhesha watu kwa nambari ya simu. Kujiondoa mara moja kunajumuisha kila nambari iliyohifadhiwa.
instructions: Hiya supplies caller ID to many Samsung phones and carrier apps. Fungua Hiya's request form at https://hiyahelp.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=33394399463699 and ask Hiya to remove the caller ID name for each of these numbers: {all_phones}. Use {contact_email} as your email. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
